newPlatforms.name: OurTownRadio Independent Artist Email and Download-Link Airplay Route
newPlatforms.country: United States (Pennsylvania); the station streams online and promotes music to a worldwide audience, but the first-party submission page does not explicitly confirm international artist eligibility.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: official first-party public business-email route accepting free download or streaming links for independent-radio airplay

authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party public music-submission email route with download-link and streaming-link delivery
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Send original independent music and supporting artist information for possible OurTownRadio airplay, promotion and featured-artist consideration.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Review the rights and promotional-use terms, confirm ownership and eligibility, select a genre-compatible MarcsMusic track, prepare metadata and approved links, and send an email only after explicit owner approval.
authorizedRoute.internationalAcceptanceEvidence: The site says submissions can be heard around the world and supports anyone releasing music, but it does not explicitly state that artists outside the United States may submit.
authorizedRoute.standardRouteFeeEvidence: No submission fee is published. The page states that featured-artist consideration is free.

review the published airplay and promotional-use rights grant before sending

emails.purpose: First-party published music-submission mailbox for independent-artist airplay consideration.

businessContact.emailStatus: The music@ourtownradio.com mailbox is first-party published on the dedicated submission page, syntactically valid, domain aligned and explicitly designated for music submissions.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and stated purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: No submission form or CAPTCHA is used by the published email route.
formBoundary.loginStatus: No account or login requirement is published for the email submission route.
formBoundary.paymentStatus: No submission payment is published; featured-artist consideration is stated to be free.
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Human review is required for rights and promotional-use terms, international and AI eligibility, track selection, ownership verification and final email authorization.
rightsOrConsentFields: submission grants OurTownRadio rights to use the music for airplay and promotion
Terms of Service describe a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to host content for public airplay and advertising promotions
adjacentRoutesExcluded: temporary-site links referenced from older airplay articles
physical CD delivery as a separate duplicate opportunity

activityVerification.evidence: The first-party Submit Music page displayed a July 11, 2026 weekly Top 10, current track listings and upcoming scheduled shows, demonstrating recent station activity.

genreFitEvidence: The submission page accepts Indie, Pop, Acoustic, Rock, R&B, Hip hop, Hard Rock, Screamo, Country, Folk, Punk and unusual or experimental music.
The station accepts almost all music genres and invites one song or a full album.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic crossover, pop, hip-hop, reggae-adjacent or experimental tracks may fit after human track-level review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The authorized email route is active, free and domain aligned, but the rights and promotional-use grant must be reviewed; international and AI eligibility are not explicit; ownership and track fit must be confirmed; and the final email or file-transfer action requires explicit owner approval.

dedupeTerms: OurTownRadio Independent Artist Email and Download-Link Airplay Route
deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Searches in the accessible repository code-search surface for OurTownRadio, the canonical domain and the official submission mailbox returned no match before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The dedicated submission page, official mailbox, download/streaming-link guidance and optional physical-delivery address are consolidated as one canonical opportunity.

notes: One OurTownRadio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no file was uploaded, no account or login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
